callouts.text: 1 · Select EstimatePairOut, then click any attribute line. It becomes one normal source field: paste, type, and press Enter wherever you need.
2 · Hover pose, then click its chevron. The nested position tree folds; the closed chevron remains visible.
3 · Open Dev and enable Chevrons in code gutter. Fold handles align left; turn it off to return them beside text.
PASS WHEN · The Type stays compact in Port view, source edits preserve the exact text, nested attributes fold and reopen, and both chevron placements stay readable.
